absent_because.max_decompressed_bytes: this adapter inflates nothing: a compressed file is unwrapped by synapse-decode --container gzip under the host's own bounds before the adapter is handed it
absent_because.max_objects: not a bound of its own: one Event per line and at most one Entity per line, and a line is at least 34 octets (the date, the time, a nine-character AQSID, a value and the delimiters), so max_input_bytes bounds the count
absent_because.max_parse_seconds: no wall-clock bound is enforced: this module reads no clock, and every pass over the file is one walk of its lines and fields; the conformance suite's parser worker kills a decode that overruns its deadline

max_depth.enforced_at: `Adapter.__init_subclass__`'s wrapper calls `adapter.enforce_depth_bound` on a dict before this class's `to_cdm` runs
max_depth.source: The octets are never JSON; the parsed twin nests three containers (the twin, its lines, a line). 64 (`MAX_DEPTH`, `adapters/airnow_hourly.py`) is the harness loader's own bound and the figure the JSON-reading adapters of synapse_cdm declare. This is an IMPLEMENTATION CAP and is NOT the format's normative maximum.

max_input_bytes.enforced_at: `Adapter.__init_subclass__` wraps this class's own `to_cdm` with `enforce_input_bound` at class-definition time (`adapter.py`, `_bind_input_bound`), so the octets are measured and refused before this module decodes a line
max_input_bytes.source: No AirNow document states a maximum size for an hourly file. The design record's figure is one HourlyData file of 7878 lines for one hour, every publicly approved site in AirNow (research-station-text F08), and a HourlyAQObs file is one line a site. DECISIONS U-07 rules one station-text file at most 8 MiB (8 388 608 octets, `MAX_INPUT_BYTES`, `adapters/airnow_hourly.py`), with the CO-OPS request range limits (research-station-text F05) the class's other stated unit. This is an IMPLEMENTATION CAP and is NOT the format's normative maximum.

message_types: EPA AirNow HourlyData_yyyymmddhh.dat (header-less, |-delimited) or HourlyAQObs_yyyymmddhh.dat (quoted CSV), one file per call, as its octets or its parsed twin; one ENVIRONMENTAL_OBSERVATION Event per line carrying point-observation/1, and one Entity per site
capabilities.unknown_fields_basis: a HourlyData line is exactly the fact sheet's nine fields and a HourlyAQObs header exactly the 34 names the files write (OZONE_Measured where the fact sheet's list spells Ozone_Measured), so a field this module does not know is refused rather than carried; the twin's keys are closed and an injected key is refused `not-a-twin`

format.name: EPA AirNow hourly observation files (HourlyData, HourlyAQObs)
format.version: AirNow Hourly Data File fact sheet (last updated August 2025) and Hourly AQ Obs File fact sheet (updated March 2023)

limitations.summary: HourlyData and HourlyAQObs files are read; the forecast file (reportingarea.dat), the site file (monitoring_site_locations.dat), the API's responses and EPA AQS records are not, and nothing is joined from another file

a HourlyData line states no position: it comes only from a caller's site table (a StationTable keyed by AQSID), else the site Entity's position is null; a HourlyAQObs line's Latitude and Longitude are its stated position, and its Elevation, whose datum the fact sheet does not state, stays in the residual
a stamp is the GMT start of a one-hour period: validity.effective is [start, start + 1 h] and observed_at its end; the GMT offset (to local standard time) is never applied
a HourlyAQObs AQI field is carried with the unit AQI under the fact sheet's definition, an index with no other unit; a concentration's unit is its own *_Unit field, verbatim

a HourlyAQObs line stating neither an AQI nor a concentration is refused no-reading, and a HourlyData line with a blank value or unit is refused blank-value: the fact sheets say only valid data are reported, and the design record holds no such line

AirNow's hourly files carry no per-value quality flag, so every contract states quality_flags_basis; the data are preliminary, and the AirNow Data Exchange Guidelines' terms bind the consumer, not this package
`evidence.available` is false because no published Release carries this adapter's records yet; it becomes true at the first release that attaches them

maturity.basis: L3 PROVENANCE VERIFIED, from evidence that runs today in this package: `synapse_cdm.harness --adapter airnow_hourly` over the packaged fixture set reports `translate`, `schema` and `provenance` PASS on every fixture, which carries L1 to L3, and its `lossless` column rests on the path-bound ledger (`MAPPINGS` declared, every line a structured residual on its own Event) with no LOST leaf on any parsed twin. L4 is NOT declared: this adapter is ingest-only, so the roundtrip check is inapplicable rather than passed (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.6, rule 4), and a rung passed vacuously is not a rung declared.
